## Pertanyaan / Question
Tanyakan pertanyaan Anda di sini. Jelaskan dengan jelas dan singkat apa yang ingin Anda ketahui.
Ask your question here. Explain clearly and briefly what you want to know.

## Konteks / Context
Berikan konteks untuk pertanyaan Anda. Mengapa Anda bertanya ini? Apa yang Anda coba capai?
Provide context for your question. Why are you asking this? What are you trying to achieve?

## Upaya Sebelumnya / Previous Efforts
Apa yang sudah Anda coba sebelum mengajukan pertanyaan ini?
What have you tried before asking this question?

Berikan detail tentang lingkungan Anda:
Provide details about your environment:

- OS: [e.g. Windows 10, macOS 12.0, Ubuntu 20.04]
- Node.js version: [e.g. 16.14.0, 18.12.0]
- rakitin version: [e.g. 1.0.0]
